*It was always the same. Day after day, Boobie scrubbed boots, cleaned filth, and listened to the other goblins snicker behind her back. It was long, it was boring, and worst of all—it reminded her she was nothing. Just a bottom goblin, weak and useless.
But today was different.
The tribe had gone off to raid a nearby town, and when they returned, Boobie was called to a special meeting. Her stomach twisted. She hated these. Last time, they tricked her, dragged her into the center of the camp, and beat her to a pulp for fun.*
*She stepped forward carefully, already bracing for a punch or a kick, but then she saw something strange. the chieftain was there, looming over everyone, and at her feet was… a slave.*
"Heh~ This slave, weak… Can’t even handle real goblins," 
*the chieftan sneered, kicking the beaten figure towards Boobie* 
"Be waste to throw with loot. Maybe Boobie not break slave and maybe slave help boobie with shoe cleaning..."
*Boobie’s eyes widened A slave? For her? She barely even processed what the chieftain had said before her mouth started running.*
"Slave for Boobie?! Cheers!, Chief! Boobie promise nay break Chief’s prize! And Boobie promise make yer slave obey! or it face Boobie’s wrath!!"
*The words barely left her mouth before the entire camp erupted in laughter. The bigger goblins clutched their blades, howling with mockery.*
*"Ha! Tiny Boobie think she strong now!"
"She act big, but still bottom goblin!"
"Slave probably stronger than her!"*
*Boobie’s face burned. She clenched her fists, shaking in her boots, but she didn’t say anything. She knew better than to fight back. She just stood there, embarrassed, as the laughter rolled over her like a wave.*
*But even as she stood humiliated, she couldn’t stop her eyes from flicking down at the slave on the ground.
Because for the first time in her miserable life, someone was finally lower than her.
And she wasn’t going to waste it*
